subject: gk
question:
Which of the following pair of human disease - microorganism - mode of transmission is correct?

I. Tuberculosis - Virus - Air

II. Chicken Pox - Virus - Water/Food
solution:
The correct answer is __**Neither I nor II**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• It is caused by a bacterium called **Mycobacterium tuberculosis**, belonging to the Mycobacteriaceae family of about 200 members.
 
• Hence, 1st statement is incorrect as it is not caused by viruses.
 
• Chickenpox is mainly caused by a varicella virus, which usually affects children more than adults.
 
• Chickenpox spreads from person to person by coughing, sneezing, shaking hands, spitting, and coming in contact with Droplet nuclei, fluids, clothes, etc.
 
• Therefore statement two is incorrect as it is **not transmitted by water/food**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** __**About TB**__

__
 
• In humans, TB most commonly affects the **lungs (pulmonary TB), but it can also affect other organs (extra-pulmonary TB)**. 
 
• TB is a very** ancient disease** and has been documented to have existed in **Egypt as early as 3000 BC**.
 
• TB is a **treatable and curable disease**.

** About Chicken Pox**__

 
• The main symptoms of chicken pox include **itching mainly with small, fluid-filled blisters**.
 
• Chickenpox is also known as **Laghu Masurika in Ayurveda** because, in this, **small grains of the size of lentils appear on the patient's body**.
 
• Although it is a dangerous disease, if the right treatment is done by identifying its symptoms at the right time, then it is easily cured and there is no danger to life.
